It sounds like you're looking to learn more about a particular career or field of study—maybe to help guide your own decisions. That's a really thoughtful step to take.

A few good ways to connect with someone in that role: reach out on LinkedIn with a polite message explaining you're curious about their path, ask a school career center or academic advisor if they can arrange an informational interview, or see if family, friends, or professors know someone in the field. Most people are happy to share their experience when asked genuinely. When you talk with them, feel free to ask exactly what you mentioned—their courses, how long they studied, and whether they enjoy the work day to day. Would it help to think through who you might reach out to first?
